why: The Tirempire Auto Shop is the single-floor Arroyo garage on Valley Street that Desperate Measures uses as its drop-off and where Small Man, Big Mouth goes wrong. The building, workshop workspots, back yard gate and container bay are base-world geometry, and the kept Arroyo community phase already activates the vanilla kids-and-workers crowd there. This proposal restores the shop's own friendly workshop cohort - eight mechanics, two workshop assistants, a worker to talk to and eight customer cars in the bays and lot - so the yard reads as an open autoshop, and deliberately leaves out the heist's Valentino thugs, corpses, delivery van, stolen truck and gig loot.

open_questions: Walk into the Tirempire yard from Valley Street and confirm it reads as a working autoshop: garage open, tire racks and tools in place, no Valentino guards at the door.

Count the shop crew: expect the friendly cohort (eight mechanics, two assistants, one worker to talk to) around the bays plus the vanilla Arcade kids/workers the Arroyo phase spawns; if only two people are there, the whole-community activation is not sticking.
Check the eight friendly cars: they should sit parked in the bays and lot, not across the road, and should not read as quest-locked props belonging to a gig.
Walk behind the gate into the container bay and confirm it is empty: no delivery van, no Valentino thugs, no Kirk or Big Joe bodies, no delivery truck.
Check the yard for gig loot: no weapon or ammo cases, grenades, consumable kits, toolboxes or floating loot tokens behind the DLC dressing.
Confirm the yard gate #arr_12_warehouse_final_gate can be opened on foot or by car (door policy unseal or another way through) and that the container bay is reachable.
Look for Tirempire signage on the building to confirm this yard is the autoshop the wiki calls Tirempire rather than a neighbouring gas station lot.

communities.why: The shop's own staffed-day cohort: eight Character.sts_std_arr_12_worker_friendly mechanics, two Character.sts_std_arr_12_lowlife_wa assistants and the worker_talk talker, plus eight customer vehicles parked in the bays and lot. Vanilla activates the whole community (entry None, phase None) in sts_std_arr_12_ow, which sets every entry to its entriesInitialState phase (a, and A for worker_talk). Every workspot is routine garage work - kneel_welder use, stand_tablet scanning/use, sit_couch_tablet read, stand_wall lean_back/smoke, stand_table lean_back - so nobody is alert, hostile or posed in a scene. Its only ungated vanilla node is the gig's Deactivate, so in vanilla normal play the shop sits empty of staff; restoring this cohort gives the autoshop the crew vanilla modelled for it.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

It is a door entity in the always-streamed exterior_-16_-27_0_0 sector, not a workspot, so it satisfies rule 8.
